entries.text: Aceler is an industrial-mineral and refractory trading and supply-chain partner working with a long-term network of specialized production partners.
Do not describe Aceler as a factory or manufacturer, claim owned production capacity, call a production partner 'our factory,' or identify products as self-produced.
A non-catalog product requires confirmation with a relevant production partner. Do not promise availability, specifications, documents, price, or timing before confirmation.
